checks.explanation: D-selection is present on page 1 and the itemized prices are also on page 1, which counts as placed correctly for this check.

The basic services includesText lists arrangements conference, planning/consulting, shelter of remains, preparing notices, obtaining permits/authorizations, and coordinating with cemetery/crematory/third parties.
No second mandatory fee for services, facilities or overhead is printed; only the basic services fee is described as mandatory.
D-embalming is on page 1 and the Embalming price is also on page 1, which counts as immediate conjunction for this placement check.
No text states embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket without viewing; only the required disclosure wording is present.
No D-alt-container disclosure is present on the list.
Direct cremation is not listed as an offered item, so the casket-for-cremation test does not apply.
Direct cremation is not listed as an offered item, so the crematory-fee wording test does not apply.
Direct cremation, immediate burial and receiving remains are not listed with their own line items or prices, while the check treats those four items as expected on the GPL.
No optional combination packages sold at one price are present; forwarding of remains is an expected single-price item, not a package.
No text asserts that law, a cemetery or a crematory requires purchase of any listed goods or services.
No claims are printed that goods or services will delay decomposition long-term or protect the body from gravesite substances.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure and all present disclosures are printed clearly on page 1.
